pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacconist's Spectacles$() are the normal inspection tool for the mod. Wear them and look directly at a supported crop or processing block to open a compact information panel beside the crosshair.

pages.title: Tobacconist's Spectacles
pages.text: String, two Glass Panes, and one Copper Ingot.

$(thing)Without Curios:$() equip the Spectacles in the vanilla head slot. $(br2)$(thing)With Curios:$() you may use the Curios Head slot instead, keeping your helmet slot free. The same forehead visual and the same inspection overlay are used either way.
pages.title: How to Wear Them

pages.text: $(thing)Crops$(): variety, growth %, environmental Conditions, potential quality when quality is enabled, and a Ready to Harvest notice. $(br2)$(thing)Drying Racks$(): contents, cure method, progress, time remaining or paused state, and quality. $(br2)$(thing)Barrels$(): contents, mode, progress, age, fermentation/ruin state, warmth, humidity, and quality.
pages.title: What They Show

pages.text: For crops, $(thing)Conditions$() means the environment only: biome, light, and temperature. Crop age is intentionally separate. A young healthy plant can therefore have Good or Excellent conditions even though its eventual harvest potential is still held back by being immature.
pages.title: Conditions vs. Potential
